subject: Phase 100330: `am setup` First-Run Wizard and Deployment Configuration
verdict_justification: The phase implements the core wizard flows, default XDG deployment path resolution, atomic write, and backup-before-replace with high test coverage (>97% lines, >98% functions). However, it violates a hard AGENTS.md rule by introducing a 469-line file (tests.rs), contains an unisolated TTY check that hangs `cargo test` when executed in interactive terminals, leaks phase numbers in code comments, and misleadingly lists Postgres as a local service in zero-dependency installs.

AGENTS.md: Roadmap isolation — never reference ./roadmap/, phase numbers, or roadmap files from code or comments
AGENTS.md / coverage.md: Workspace and per-file >=90% function and line coverage floors
roadmap/phase-100330-am-setup-wizard.md: Zero-dependency, airgapped, and custom install types with non-interactive flag support
roadmap/phase-100330-am-setup-wizard.md §5 Task 4 & §8 T100330-09: Tests must run non-interactively without a TTY and never block

issues.title: crates/clio-config/src/config/tests.rs exceeds 450-line limit (469 lines) in violation of AGENTS.md
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md mandates a hard limit of <=450 lines for all Rust files. The developer modified this file (growing it from 430 to 469 lines) and falsely claimed in the run log that all modified files were <=450 lines.
issues.impact: Violates hard repo governance constraint and blocks phase completion.
issues.evidence: `wc -l crates/clio-config/src/config/tests.rs` returns 469 lines. The developer added 39 lines for `default_deployment_path_is_loaded_and_can_be_disabled` without decomposing the file.
issues.proposed_fix: Extract the newly added deployment path tests from tests.rs into persist_tests.rs or a dedicated test module to bring tests.rs under 450 lines.
issues.resolution: Moved `default_deployment_path_is_loaded_and_can_be_disabled` from tests.rs into crates/clio-config/src/config/persist_tests.rs (its default-path-resolution scope). `wc -l crates/clio-config/src/config/tests.rs` now returns 430 (<=450).

issues.title: Test suite hangs in interactive terminals due to unisolated TTY stdin in setup_usage_errors_exit_2
issues.why_it_matters: Running `cargo test --locked --workspace` or `make check` directly in any interactive terminal (without `</dev/null`) blocks indefinitely on `std::io::stdin()`.
issues.impact: Freezes standard developer workflows and local test runs for any engineer using an interactive terminal.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main_tests.rs:61-68. `setup_usage_errors_exit_2` invokes `run(vec!["setup".into()])`. `setup_cli::setup` evaluates `std::io::stdin().is_terminal()`, which is true in terminal shells, prompting `Install type: [1] zero-dependency, [2] airgapped, [3] custom:` and blocking.
issues.proposed_fix: Decouple `main_tests.rs` from live process stdin by passing non-interactive flags or routing CLI execution in tests through an injected, non-terminal stream seam.
issues.resolution: setup_usage_errors_exit_2 no longer relies on ambient TTY state: the missing --type assertion now passes --non-interactive, which fails fast at exit 2 without prompting, so cargo test never blocks in an interactive terminal. Test output: `test tests::setup_usage_errors_exit_2 ... ok`. Coverage of the auto non-TTY path remains in setup_cli::fail_tests::missing_or_unknown_type_exits_2 (setup_core with is_tty=false).

issues.title: Roadmap isolation violations in code comments referencing 'phase'
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md strictly prohibits mentioning roadmap files, phases, or phase numbers in code and comments.
issues.impact: Leaks ephemeral project management concepts into permanent source code comments.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/setup_wizard.rs:304 ('/// compose phase, so Docker argument construction stays in one place.') and crates/clio-lib/src/setup_wizard_tests.rs:69 ('// Extraction is never configured this phase.').
issues.proposed_fix: Remove or rephrase comments to refer to architectural components (e.g. `am compose` CLI) rather than phase names.
issues.resolution: setup_wizard.rs:303 now reads 'Start the local portion through the `am compose` surface, so Docker argument construction stays in one place.'; setup_wizard_tests.rs:69 now reads '// Setup does not configure hosted extraction (not available yet).'. `rg -n '\bphase\b' crates/clio-lib/src/` returns no production/comment matches.

issues.title: am setup falsely reports 'local services: postgres' for zero-dependency installs
issues.why_it_matters: Zero-dependency installs are defined as requiring no Docker and starting no local services, using embedded SQLite. Falsely listing postgres as a local service misleads operators into believing Postgres is running or needed.
issues.impact: Misleading CLI output that contradicts the documented contract of the zero-dependency install type.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/setup_wizard.rs:198-210. `Plan::local_services()` unconditionally initializes `vec!["postgres"]`. Running `am setup --type zero-dependency ...` reports `local services: postgres`.
issues.resolution: Plan::local_services() now pushes "postgres" only when install_type != ZeroDependency; report() prints `local services:    none` when the list is empty. `am setup --type zero-dependency` no longer reports postgres; zero_dependency_runs_no_docker_and_writes_config asserts `local services:    none`.

issues.title: Switching install types merges over old credentials instead of removing them, leaking hosted API keys into airgapped configs
issues.why_it_matters: Airgapped installations are specified to run with no external keys. If an operator switches from zero-dependency to airgapped, the old API keys remain in deployment.json despite setup stating it replaced existing values.
issues.impact: Lingering secret keys remain in configuration files for deployments intended to be airgapped.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/setup_config.rs:104-114. `write` only sets fields from `plan.entries()` on top of `rt.deployment_overlay`. An airgapped setup run over a pre-existing zero-dependency config leaves `credentials.embed_api_key` in the file.
issues.proposed_fix: When writing a full setup plan, remove provider and credential fields from the deployment overlay that are not configured by the new install type.
issues.resolution: New `Runtime::remove_deployment_fields(&[&str]) -> usize` (crates/clio-config/src/config/mod.rs) and setup_config::write now prunes every WATCHED_FIELDS entry the new plan does not write before staging, so switching zero-dependency -> airgapped removes credentials.embed_api_key and embed.dims from the file. Test write_prunes_stale_credentials_when_the_install_type_drops_them proves `saved.get("credentials").is_none()` after an airgapped-style write; unwatched keys (e.g. backend) still survive (write_persists_once_and_backs_up_the_previous_config).

issues.title: Incomplete XDG absolute path validation on HOME fallback in default_deployment_path
issues.why_it_matters: The doc comment states that relative base directories are ignored per XDG spec, but while XDG_CONFIG_HOME checks is_absolute(), HOME does not.
issues.impact: Inconsistent path handling between XDG_CONFIG_HOME and HOME fallbacks.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/config/persist.rs:74-77. `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` uses `.filter(|dir| Path::new(dir).is_absolute())`, while `HOME` lacks the `is_absolute()` check.
issues.proposed_fix: Add `.filter(|home| Path::new(home).is_absolute())` to the `HOME` lookup in `default_deployment_path`.
issues.resolution: persist.rs default_deployment_path now applies `.filter(|home| Path::new(home).is_absolute())` to HOME; resolve_defaults_follow_xdg_then_home asserts `resolve_deployment_path_with(None, lookup(&[("HOME", "rel")])) == None`.

issues.title: Potential atomic file write collision with static temporary file name in write_private_atomic
issues.why_it_matters: The temporary file used for atomic replacement is always named `.{name}.tmp`. Concurrent saves or reloads across threads or processes can clobber the shared temporary file before rename.
issues.impact: Potential race conditions or corrupt temporary writes under concurrent invocation.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/config/persist.rs:207-213. `temp_sibling` constructs `.{name}.tmp` without a PID or uniqueness token.
issues.proposed_fix: Include process ID and a timestamp or monotonic counter in the temporary file name.
issues.resolution: temp_sibling now names the temp file `.{name}.{pid}.{nanos}.tmp` (std::process::id + UNIX_EPOCH nanos), so concurrent saves cannot clobber each other's temp file before rename. persist_tests save_is_owner_only_and_round_trips asserts two consecutive temp_sibling calls differ.

strengths: Comprehensive unit and negative testing covering flag parsing, prompt IO errors, and fallback paths
Owner-only Unix permission enforcement (0600 on files, 0700 on backup directories)
Clean validate-then-write architecture preventing partial config corruption on disk
High overall coverage with all touched components significantly above the 90% floor
regrets: Developer failed to verify line counts across all modified files before declaring done
Developer assumed stdin in cargo test is always non-terminal, causing test hangs in developer shells
process_changes: Enforce automated pre-commit or CI check on `wc -l` <= 450 lines for all Rust files
Ensure all CLI tests mocking commands use explicit mock reader/writer streams rather than calling process-level `main::run()` directly
plan_1hr: Move `default_deployment_path_is_loaded_and_can_be_disabled` from `crates/clio-config/src/config/tests.rs` to `persist_tests.rs` to bring `tests.rs` under 450 lines.
Isolate `setup_usage_errors_exit_2` in `crates/clio-lib/src/main_tests.rs` so it does not block on live terminal stdin during `cargo test`.
Remove 'compose phase' and 'this phase' comments in `setup_wizard.rs` and `setup_wizard_tests.rs` to restore roadmap isolation.
plan_unlimited: Prune or clear obsolete credentials from `deployment_overlay` when re-running `am setup` with a different install type so stale secrets are not retained in airgapped mode.
Ensure atomic config writes use unique temporary filenames (including PID and timestamp) to prevent race conditions during concurrent saves.
Validate that `HOME` is absolute in `default_deployment_path` matching XDG requirements.

remediation.mode: All 7 findings fixed serially by the remediator (no workers: fixes are small and coupled through shared test files setup_support_tests and persist_tests.rs).

Touched files: clio-config/src/config/mod.rs 100%f/99.17%l, persist.rs 93.94%/95.58%, clio-lib/src/setup_wizard.rs 100%/99.02%, setup_config.rs 100%/98.08%.
test_mechanism_changes: write_reports_flush_failure_after_backup renamed to write_reports_flush_failure_without_replacing: the F-07 unique temp-name fix makes the old .deployment.json.tmp collision trick impossible, so flush failure is now forced by occupying the parent directory slot with a file (backup correctly reports nothing existed). The flush-failure error closure stays covered.

write_persists_once_and_backs_up_the_previous_config updated: second write now prunes watched fields the plan no longer writes (F-05 contract) and adds an explicit assertion that unwatched keys (backend) survive. This strengthens, not weakens, the tested contract.
remediation.recommendation_changes: None; all original recommendations were implemented as proposed.
